So PLAN.md §7's `title=Foo` example is WRONG (flagged for Mirko in nextAction; PLAN.md deliberately NOT edited by the loop). ANSWERED the iter11 open question: a title with spaces is NOT quoted. (3) CRITICAL Markdig detail that the old code got wrong: with the DEFAULT info parser (FencedBlockParserBase.DefaultInfoParser, read at tag 1.3.2), FencedCodeBlock.Info holds ONLY the first token — the line is split at the first whitespace and the trimmed remainder goes to FencedCodeBlock.Arguments, which the old renderer never read. So the attributes were not merely mis-parsed, they were in a property nobody looked at. IMPLEMENTATION: ParseInfoLine rejoins Info + Arguments and scans it token by token (so the parse does not depend on where Markdig split), producing a private readonly record struct CodeFenceAttributes(Language, Collapse, LineNumbers, FirstLine, Title); Write emits the params in mark's order via a WriteParameter helper that XML-escapes the value as element content (the title is author text and can carry & < >). Supported attributes: collapse, nocollapse, linenumbers, a positive integer (Confluence's firstline, which also turns line numbering on, per mark's README table), and `title <rest of line>`. Keyword matching is case-insensitive (mark's is not) since widening what is understood can never silently misread a token. A repeated attribute takes its last value (`collapse nocollapse` -> not collapsed), matching mark's loop.
